title: Decky Legacy Profile (ABI v1)
description: Exact schema for the legacy Decky plugin profile ABI at the generated root profiles/<id>.json. This shape is frozen — it must never change without a new ABI version — because the existing Decky plugin reads it directly. It is always generated (via internal/profile.BuildExportPlan) from the canonical library/profiles/<id>/profile.json (see canonical-profile.schema.json / model.Profile), never authored by hand and never the source of truth.

version.description: Frozen ABI version marker. Any breaking change to this shape requires version 2 and a migration, never an in-place edit of v1.

id.description: Must equal the filename stem, i.e. profiles/<id>.json.

description.description: Optional. Absent entirely when there is no description (not null).

artwork.description: Profile-level artwork override. A string is a safe-ID token identifying the generated legacy artwork set to apply (e.g. the profile's own id, as in the "steam-default" fixture below); null explicitly means "no art change" (leave whatever is currently applied) — these are two distinct, both-valid states. This field is never omitted — omission is not a valid substitute for null. Separately, when internal/profile.BuildExportPlan renders a Decky export whose plan has no other actions, it also writes a generated marker file at artwork/<id>/grid/.deck-profile-empty on disk to represent an intentionally empty artwork set; that marker is unrelated to whether this JSON field is a string or null.

mods.description: Optional per-game mod selections; omission defaults to an empty list. At most one entry per distinct "game" value in this array (unique per game) — enforced by validation tooling in addition to this schema, since plain JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness keyed on a single object property. Each entry is a complete set: applying it fully replaces any prior mod selection for that game, with no partial/merge semantics.

$comment: Reserved ids: "deck-default" and "steam-default" are always retained and never pruned by garbage collection. The real steam-default fixture (testdata/decky/steam-default.json) has artwork == "steam-default" and explicit mods == []; its grid contains only .deck-profile-empty. Although mods is optional on input and defaults empty, deterministic generated profiles emit mods: []. artwork == null is a separate valid state meaning leave current art unchanged.
